doc: Chapter 2, STS-61, the first Hubble servicing mission (December 1993) (issue #46; story: docs/design/story-v0.3.0.md). Every fact from NASA pages (S-hubble-sm1, S-sts61-nasa, S-nasa-9408670, S-m100-pia22913). The cuyes never change history: Killa insists on cleaning the lens and nobody lets her (the story's line). Same format as apollo13.json.
mission: Between intro and outro the player plays the mission: five spacewalks, the right part in the right order within the time, then the first sharp image (scripts/screens/sts61.gd).

intro.text: Twenty-three years after Apollo 13, the cuyes stowed away again. This time, to fix a telescope.
Houston here. Hubble's mirror has a flaw: every picture comes out fuzzy.
intro.fact: Two months after Hubble's launch in April 1990, scientists found a flaw in its main mirror: one-fiftieth of the width of a human hair.

intro.text: A blurry telescope? Give me a cloth. I will clean it.
Nobody lets Killa clean the mirror.
Flight day three: the arm grabbed Hubble and stood it up in our bay.
intro.fact: On flight day three, Claude Nicollier used the robot arm to stand the 13-meter Hubble upright in the payload bay.

intro.text: Five spacewalks. New parts, in the right order, and glasses for the telescope.
intro.fact: It took five back-to-back spacewalks totaling 35 hours and 28 minutes to complete Hubble's first servicing mission.

outro.text: Sharp! And I did not clean anything.
Endeavour lands on December 13. Next time, somewhere with ground.
outro.fact: Endeavour landed on December 13, 1993, after 10 days, 19 hours and 58 minutes in space.

outro.text: Next stop: Mars. I hear you land by bouncing.
